entries.text: Mark days played with an hourglass and the best day with a gold star
Count bosses killed and show each stat's icon beside its number
Give the Account stats their own OSRS icons
Show the How to Play stone on the start screen
Open the recent updates from the start screen
Keep the Collection Log tabs still when you switch pages
Let you resize the interface from the start screen
Show the Collection Log above the start screen
Keep the start screen steady when you switch modes
Let the lobby torches crackle
Give each daily challenge one boon and one curse
Light the start screen with a torch-lit castle lobby
Split the start screen into Play, Daily and Account tabs
A pool turns to lava when the run travels into the TzHaar city
Kill a Tz-Kek and two smaller ones crawl out of it
A level requirement shows the icon of the skill that grants it
A fish sells for the coins its Sell line promised
Every brew names the herb it spends, and shows its icon
See which diary reward your towers are wearing right now
Each Achievement Diary hands its region's own reward to every tower
Read every region's Achievement Diary in the Collection Log
Every region keeps an Achievement Diary, and clearing a task announces itself
Vannaka and Konar join the masters, and Konar's tasks name a region
Fishing, Farming and Hunter drop their own OSRS pets
The TzHaar cavern floor is bare basalt instead of a scatter of lava slabs and troughs
Mor Ul Rek trades the champion's display for the cavern's own columns and crates
Trees and rocks on a shoreline stand in front of the water instead of behind it
The Wilderness is strewn with real skeletons and Mor Ul Rek's floor is black rock under its lava
The TzHaar cavern steams from a scatter of sulphur vents instead of one on every free tile
TzHaar's vents cool to black basalt and its floor pools lava instead of hairline cracks
The TzHaar cavern's floor bubbles through sulphur vents instead of flat lava splats
Trollweiss' bare green pines are frosted over like the rest of the snowfield
The daily result screen now shows the last week of dailies and your streak
A Daily Challenge gives everyone the same map and the same waves each day, and keeps your best run
Every boss now drops its own pet, and the one you pick walks beside your base
TzHaar's lava seams crack open over the rock and the boulders become Inferno roof pillars
The TzHaar throne stands as a single pair and lava fills the floor it leaves behind
TzHaar trades its sulphur for lava pools and Morytania grows a dead swamp
One chaos altar per map, fewer graves, and TzHaar trades its stalagmites for city stone
The tallest trees and stalagmites lose half their height, and TzHaar's fences are gone
